source_ncvs: National Crime Victimization Survey (NCVS), Race and Hispanic Origin of Victims and Offenders, 2012–15 (BJS)
source_homicide: FBI Supplementary Homicide Reports via OJJDP Statistical Briefing Book / 2022 National Report
notes: NCVS data: nonfatal violent crime (rape/sexual assault, robbery, aggravated assault, simple assault) for ages 12–17. Offender race is the victim’s perception.
Homicide rates: published youth (under 18) victimization rates by race from FBI SHR/OJJDP. These are rates of being killed, not the race of the offender.
No published national summary provides the victim-race × offender-race cross-tab for child homicide victims.
Red ✕ indicates data that is not published in available official summaries.

homicide_rates_per_100k.note: Approximate rates for youth ages 0–17, around 2019 (OJJDP/FBI SHR). Exact year and definition vary slightly by table.
